name: Pewter City & Boulder Badge Gym
summary: Historic stone-quarried city nestled in the foothills of Mt. Moon. Home of the Pewter Museum of Science, multiple valuable early-game sidequests, and Gym Leader Brock's Gym.

items.name: Fusion Incense
items.method: Found tucked between the flower patch and the trees

items.name: Fresh Water
items.method: Given by the Gym Guide just inside the entrance of Pewter Gym

items.name: Black Flute
items.method: Gifted by the traveler sitting on the city bench immediately after defeating Brock

items.name: Revive
items.method: Found under a bench in Pewter City after accepting the Youngster's quest in the hotel

items.name: TM21 (Frustration)
items.method: Reward from the Youngster in the Pewter Hotel after returning his lost Revive

items.name: Balm Mushroom
items.method: Reward from the chef in Pewter Hotel after giving her 3 Tiny Mushrooms from Viridian Forest

items.name: Partner Cap
items.method: Reward from the Pikachu in the Poké Mart after finding its official League Hat

move_tutors.name: Metronome Move Tutor
move_tutors.location: Inside the Pewter Museum of Science (eastern lab)
move_tutors.notes: Teaches Metronome, executing a completely random move from the entire game.

move_tutors.name: Mud-Slap Move Tutor
move_tutors.notes: Teaches Ground-type special move Mud-Slap (100% accuracy drop).
